name: v0.5.39
body:
## Changes

### Fixes
- Replace Stdio::piped() with conpty crate (Windows Pseudo-Console)
- Fix terminal panel showing blank output (cmd.exe requires real console)
- Add ConptyProcess wrapper for Send+Sync safety
- Auto-prepend llama-server.exe to custom commands
- Convert multi-line commands to single-line before execution
- Use fresh configs from useConfigs() instead of stale Zustand store
